item.tib: gangs can bod kyi brda yang dag par sbyor ba ming gi bstan bcos legs par bshad pa blo gsal 'jug ngogs rin po che'i gter khyim
item.coloph: ces gangs can bod kyi brda' yang dag par sbyor ba'i ming gi bstan bcos blo gsal 'jug ngogs rin chen gter khyim zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rang gis yig ris bslab pa'i slob bu blo gros sogs don gnyer can 'ga' zhig gis snga phyi bskul ba ma zad/ rang gis kyang gshen gyi mkhas grub tshul khrims rgyal mtshan rin po ches mdzad pa'i brda sprod nyi shu bdun pa 'di ni gzhung gcig gis ming dang sbyor tshul phrad kyi thob tshul sogs dag sbyor yan lag yongs rdzogs ston pa'i legs bshad rnam dag tu 'dug cing / 'di'i le'u dang por ming gi thob tshul tsam las ha cang bsdus drags pas/ 'di'i ming gi rim pa rnams cung zad rgyas par phyes na gsar 'jug rnams la 'khrid bde bar 'dug snyam pa'i 'dun pa dang*/ dag sbyor gyi gzhung rgyas bsdus mang du mchis kyang yi ge'i byung khungs dang sbyor tshul sogs kha tshang ba zhig ma mthong ba sogs kyi rkyen la brten te/ bstan pa spyi dang bye brag gi yi ge byung khungs sbyor tshul nas bzung / mtshams sbyor phrad kyi thob tshul yan chad skabs bcu'i bdag nyid can du byas shing / gsar 'jug rmongs pa rnams kyis go sla ba'i phyir legs sbyar snyan tshig sogs kyis ma bcing zhing 'bol rtsom tshig bcad du byas te bkod pa 'di ni/ yul khri ka'i ljongs su dal rten rnyed cing / rang gzhan gyi grub mtha' kun la mi phyed pa'i dag snang rgyas kyang / dpyis su phyin pa'i nyams len gyi yon tan gang la'ang med pa'i zog po gyi na ba gshen gyi dge sbyor nam mkha' dbang phyug gam/ tshul ming kun bzang rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba'i rang lo zhe dgu'i dus tshigs/ sa skyong zhes pa shing bya lo'i 'bras ldan zla ba'i 'phel phyogs dges bar/ yul rgya nag gi nye 'dabs skyed chen thog lha mched gsum gyi ri shol/ mi med dben pa'i nags 'dabs zhig tu grub par bgyis pa 'dis kyang rgyal ba gshen gyi bstan pa rin po che gsal ba'i snang byed dam par gyur cig/
